correctness.rationale: The exact inverse DFT of each full unnormalized intensity is the weighted cyclic autocorrelation. In odd n, the two nonzero cross-lags +/-h differ; the positive geometric-mask autocorrelation ratio determines ordinary integer sum u+v, and sum plus difference modulo odd n uniquely determines unordered support by invertibility of 2. Two zero-lag equations then solve the squared magnitudes and one cross-lag solves relative phase; zero and one-sparse cases are separate. An arbitrary single mask cannot distinguish two scaled impulses, while even n real masks have explicit conjugate antipodal two-site ambiguity. Inspected CHECK.py demonstrates 905 finite support signatures and recovery/counterexample sampling; unrestricted correctness rests on the analytic proof.
